title: Compliance audit
regulation: Framework-dependent (ISO/IEC 27001, NIS2, CRA, GDPR, EU AI Act, BSI …)
purpose: The compliance audit uses a questionnaire to establish how far an organisation actually is against one or more frameworks, and reports the result back as a status report: fully, largely, partially or not compliant. It is therefore the position-finding at the start — not the expert opinion at the end (that is what the expert opinion module is for).

legalBasis.title: Scope and classification
legalBasis.intro: A compliance audit is not an expert opinion. It establishes the state of implementation in a structured and verifiable way so that gaps become visible and can be addressed by priority.
bullets: The questions are generated from the regulatory texts that have been read in (framework library) and stay tied to the respective reference.
Fulfilment is recorded per question: fulfilled, partially, not fulfilled, not applicable or open.
"Not applicable" is a scoping decision by the auditor and drops out of the assessment — it must be justifiable.
Several frameworks in one audit are possible; the level is reported per framework and overall.
The compliance audit is part of the base price and can be used with any valid licence — like the risk assessment.

implementation.title: How to work in the module
implementation.intro: Create the audit, choose frameworks, generate questions, collect answers, produce the status report. The questionnaire can go to the customer as XLSX and be read back in with their answers.
bullets: Create the audit and assign it to a company (field Company) — the assignment is the basis for billing and tenant separation.
Fill the framework library: download the regulatory text or upload it as a PDF, then read it into sections.
Generate questions: create a prompt, have the AI answer it and import the questions — or add your own questions manually.
Export the questionnaire as XLSX, have the customer fill it in and import it again (the re-import matches the answers to the questions).
Set fulfilment per question. For audits from before v7.4.0, "Adopt old assessments" takes over the earlier free-text grade once.
Produce the status report: the level is calculated from the answers, the AI only formulates the text for the customer.
If needed, derive an expert opinion from the audit (bridge to the expert opinion module) — the findings taken over are deliberately empty and must be formulated personally.

moduleSpecific.title: How the level is arrived at
moduleSpecific.intro: The compliance level is a commitment to the customer and is therefore calculated, not estimated: identical answers always produce the same level, and every level can be substantiated question by question.
bullets: Ratio = (1 × fulfilled + 0.5 × partially) ÷ (all questions − not applicable).
Open questions count in the ratio like "not fulfilled": what is not substantiated is not evidenced. An audit with 10 of 200 questions answered therefore cannot come out as "fully compliant".
Levels: fully = 100 % and nothing open · largely from 80 % · partially from 40 % · below that not compliant.
In addition, the ratio of the assessed questions only and the coverage are reported — this keeps the difference between "poorly fulfilled" and "not yet established" visible.
The AI receives the level as a given and must not change it; it substantiates the level, names the main gaps and proposes measures.
Every report is archived with the calculated state and the AI text kept apart (history), so that it remains traceable what was calculated and what was formulated.

areas.title: 📋 Overview
areas.zweck: Master data of the audit and selection of the frameworks.
pflichtfelder: Company — the audited company; without an assignment the audit is missing from the cockpit and from billing
Frameworks — one or several; they determine which texts questions are generated from
Audit focus — what the audit is limited to (scope definition)
tipps: Phrase the audit focus narrowly and in writing: it later substantiates why questions count as "not applicable".

areas.title: ❓ Questions
areas.zweck: Generate the questionnaire, record answers and fulfilment.
pflichtfelder: Question with a reference to the source (section/article)
Fulfilment: fulfilled / partially / not fulfilled / not applicable / open
Comment — for "partially" and "not fulfilled", the specific gap
areas.anleitung: Generate questions via prompt and import them, then export as XLSX, have the customer fill it in and import it again. After that, set fulfilment per question — it is the basis of the level calculation.
tipps: Use "not applicable" sparingly and always with a justification in the comment — it raises the ratio.
Do not set open questions to "not fulfilled" merely because the answer is missing: the ratio treats both the same, but the coverage shows the difference.

areas.title: 📊 Status
areas.zweck: Review the calculated compliance state and produce the message to the customer.
pflichtfelder: Fulfilment set per question (otherwise everything is "open")
areas.anleitung: Check the state, then either produce the report directly with the AI or copy the prompt and paste the answer. The level does not change as a result.
tipps: Check the coverage before reporting to the customer: below roughly 80 % the statement is thin — that belongs in the message.
The history shows the development over time and is suitable for follow-up audits.

areas.title: 📄 Report
areas.zweck: Produce and export the audit report as a document.
